entities.name: Ecclesiastical History of the English People (Bede)
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: Completed in 731 CE by the Northumbrian monk Bede (the Venerable), this history of the English Church from Julius Caesar's invasion to 731 is the single most important source for early English history. Bede pioneered the AD dating system (Anno Domini), carefully cited sources, and distinguished eyewitness from hearsay evidence — earning him the title "Father of English History."
